name: Place names
description: Off until you turn it on. Names the nearest town for places that only have coordinates, using a settlement list bundled with Centraid and looked up on this device — nothing is sent anywhere. Your own names for places always win and are never changed.
prompt: For places I have not named, find the nearest settlement in the bundled GeoNames list on this device and record it as a derived name, in bounded batches. Never touch a name I typed. Bundled data: GeoNames (geonames.org), cities15000 snapshot 2017-02-27, licensed CC-BY 3.0 — see LICENSE-GEONAMES.md.

vault.why: Reads places that have coordinates and writes only the derived gazetteer record inside address_json, through the dedicated validated command. Never writes a place's name.
